description: We are students in 9 grade. We are all interested in space sphere, and find this Hackaton as a great opportunity for us in future.
summary: We created a web-site simulator, which gives us opportunity to send 4 types of sattelites into space. You still have budget limits, so you are not creating something crazy. The base plate for our idea was SpaceFlight Simulator.
details: Your main task is to send sattellites, that collect data about Earth or asteroids from far away. You have a budget limit. What makes your task harder. There are 4 types of sattelites. You can choose a different types of engines, and each of them have their own prices and their own power. If the engine is too weak, you're not able to send anything into space. To get power for your sattelite, you can use solar panels. It surely can explain some sort of things in space for people not older than 12 years. Schools can use it to explain students the base of sending rockets to space. We hope that our simulator will help young people understand, or give the idea to do somethong by themselves.
